title: MotionLine
description: One line of motion.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): one Core Motion device-motion sample, at about 100 Hz. The file is empty exactly when recording.json's motion is null. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: t strictly increases, the attitude's norm is within 1e-3 of 1, and heading is null in the arbitrary reference frames.

attitude.description: CMDeviceMotion.attitude as a quaternion, in recording.json's motion.reference_frame.

gravity.description: Gravity in m/s^2 (converted from g, 1 g = 9.80665 m/s^2).

user_accel.description: The user's acceleration in m/s^2 (converted from g).

heading.description: Degrees clockwise from the north of motion.reference_frame (magnetic or true), from 0 up to 360; null in the two arbitrary frames, and when Core Motion gives none.

magnetic.title: MagneticField
magnetic.description: CMDeviceMotion.magneticField: the calibrated field and its accuracy.
